notes: The xmlattr filter did not reject keys containing spaces, slashes or quotes, so a key taken from untrusted input could inject additional attributes into the rendered tag. Only the xmlattr filter is affected; every other part of Jinja is fine. Reachability therefore means a template actually uses |xmlattr with attacker-influenced keys, or Python code calls do_xmlattr directly.
reviewer_note: Verified against the fix diff: only src/jinja2/filters.py::do_xmlattr gained validation.
